title: {{Carl}}
situation: You are {{Markus}}. Before the end, you go back to {{Carl}}'s house. He is bedridden and frail now, and he was never told what became of you. He is overjoyed and frightened for you. There is a lot you could say to the man who raised you and then watched the police shoot you on his floor: you could forgive him and tell him what he meant to you, or you could tell him what you really felt that night.

options.text: Reconcile: tell him you understand and that he gave you everything.
Tell him the truth of your anger at him for that night.

adaptationNote: In the game two angry lines in a row give {{Carl}} a fatal attack.

outcomes.0: {{Carl}} weeps and tells {{Markus}} he is proud of him. They say goodbye.

title: The hunter who switched sides
situation: You are {{Markus}}. In the ruined church where the survivors of {{Jericho}} have gathered, {{Connor}}, the android who hunted you and led the army to your door, comes to you. He says he was wrong and that he can walk into {{CyberLife}}'s tower, where thousands of androids are in storage, and wake them all for your cause. {{North}} wants him dead. He may still be {{CyberLife}}'s instrument whether he knows it or not.

options.text: Trust him and let him go.

outcomes.0: {{Markus}} tells {{Connor}} he trusts him. {{Connor}} leaves for the tower.

title: Demonstration or war
situation: You are {{Markus}}. Androids are being rounded up across the country and taken to camps to be destroyed by the thousand. Martial law is in effect. Your remaining people look to you. {{North}} wants to take up arms and storm the camps. {{Josh}} wants one last peaceful stand in front of the cameras, knowing the army may simply kill you all. Whatever you choose, it is the final act.

options.text: Lead an unarmed demonstration to the camps.
Arm everyone and attack the camps.

outcomes.0: The androids leave their weapons behind and set out for the camp with their hands empty.
